svg.aria-label: Issue #03: Clinical Action Prediction (2024–Now). A spatio-temporal graph neural network in PyTorch Geometric with CUDA graphs that predicts a patient's next 5 clinical actions at 82% precision. Integrated PubMedBERT embeddings with the Athena database and applied outlier-sensitive min-max scaling, reducing noise by 18%. Built with Dream Team Engineering.
